description: List the people of an app, as { users, pending }. users: everyone who ever called it with X-App-User or signed in to it with a code. Each has userId (the id set_app_user_role, remove_app_user, link_app_user, list_app_user_links and send_test_push take), externalId (the developer's own id for them, or null for a user who signed in by code), name, phone (the phone they proved with a code, or null), source (api or otp), role (viewer, editor or submitter), isActive, hasAccessRow, lastSeenAt and itemCount (rows they own on the app's boards). hasAccessRow says whether they are on the app's access list: when it is false, role and isActive are only defaults, and an endpoint in row-level security mode "shared" refuses them with 403 until add_app_user or set_app_user_role puts them on the list. pending: the phones add_app_user is still holding access for, each with id, phone, role, createdAt, expiresAt and status (pending, or expired); they get in on their first sign-in with a code. Use it to see who can use the app and to find the userId of a person.

appId.description: App id or slug (from list_apps / create_app)

organizationId.description: Organization id; defaults to the credential organization when omitted

name: list_app_users
